title: Public-order clause example
purpose: Identify ambiguity, power, accountability, and rights-review questions.
clause_text: Authorities may take appropriate action against persons whose conduct may disturb public interest.

clarity.rationale: The operative terms are not defined.

specificity.rationale: Actors, conduct, evidence, scope, and boundaries are incomplete.

fairness.rationale: Notice, an opportunity to respond, appeal, and remedy are not stated.

consistency.rationale: Different authorities could reach materially different results.

accountability.rationale: Written reasons, audit records, and independent review are absent.

low_loophole_risk.rationale: Open wording permits broad interpretation and exceptions.

vague_language_risk.rationale: Appropriate and public interest are materially vague in this excerpt.

contradiction_risk.rationale: No direct contradiction is visible in this excerpt, but the full instrument is unavailable.

enforcement_discretion_risk.rationale: The authority receives broad, unexplained discretion.

exception_boundary_risk.rationale: No exception boundary, duration, expiry, or review condition is stated.

power_concentration_risk.rationale: One authority appears able to interpret and enforce the clause.

oversight_strength.rationale: No independent oversight or effective remedy is stated.
